oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident detected: embeddings route 'embeds-hot' QPS spike + elevated 5xxs across multiple workers — alert id 33321, severity P1

emma (oncall): seen it, joining

emma (oncall): looking at console — embeddings hot route QPS ~4.2k (baseline 900), p50 token latency up 2x, error rate ~6%

raj (sre): any single customer spiking?

emma (oncall): top sources: two customers (cust-A, cust-B) and a large internal batch job from platform-testing. cust-A alone ~1.6k QPS.

mike (platform): platform-testing job shouldn't run in prod — I'll check CI -> maybe a misrouted job. tagging @infra-team

lucy (prod): CS reports 3 customers complaining about slow chat responses; likely related. We should prioritize chat routes over embeddings for customer-facing SLAs.

emma (oncall): agree. plan: 1) quickly throttle embeddings route for non-prod and low-tier customers 2) carve QPS to preserve chat + rerank 3) hunt for runaway batch job and kill if prod. Anyone object?

raj (sre): +1. ready to apply quotas. Suggest target: reduce embeddings-hot global QPS by 60% and create per-customer caps: cust-A -> 150 QPS, cust-B -> 200 QPS, platform-testing -> 0 (block).

mike (platform): confirmed platform-testing job is misconfigured -> it's hitting prod endpoint. I'm killing it now.

mike (platform): killed the job. I also pushed a temporary routing rule to block requests with header `X-Env: test` to prod.

emma (oncall): executing quota changes now:
```
# decrease route QPS and add per-customer caps
infractl quota update --route embeds-hot --qps 1500 --note "emergency reduce"
infractl quota add --route embeds-hot --customer cust-A --qps 150
infractl quota add --route embeds-hot --customer cust-B --qps 200
infractl quota add --route embeds-hot --customer platform-testing --qps 0 --block true
```

emma (oncall): applied. console: embeds-hot QPS dropped to ~1.2k, errors trending down to 1.2%

support-escalations: notifying affected accounts (cust-A, cust-B) that we've applied temporary caps; CS will follow up with timeline.

lucy (prod): good. push a status note to customers: we hit automated protection to preserve chat SLAs, temporary cap applied, investigating root cause.

raj (sre): we should also stripe capacity: bump chat route weight up to preferentially route capacity. Doing quick traffic-shape:
```
infractl route-weight set --route chat --weight 1.5 --note "emergency prioritize chat"
infractl route-weight set --route embeds-hot --weight 0.5 --note "deprioritize embeds"
```

raj (sre): done. observed chat p50 latencies improving within 60s.

emma (oncall): monitoring metrics + traces. creating a short incident summary for postmortem and linking traces.

mike (platform): platform-testing job root cause: ci deploy script used prod endpoint due to env var flip in last deploy. I'll open a PR to add safeguards and a kill-switch.

lucy (prod): request to CS: flag customers eligible for credits if they experienced >2x latency for >5m. Support please gather logs.

support-escalations: acknowledged, collecting logs now. Will update affected customers in 30m.

emma (oncall): handoff: I'm rotating off in 20m. Raj, can you own the remainder of mitigation and the handoff to night oncall?

raj (sre): I can. I'll keep monitoring for 1h then onboard night oncall with runbook. Setting a reminder.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: handoff meeting at 1789004800 (T+9m).

emma (oncall): final checklist before I go: confirm platform job stopped (mike), quotas in place (emma), chat prioritized (raj), CS notified (support). All green.

mike (platform): confirmed stopped. PR inbound.

support-escalations: CS update posted to #support with customer list and message template.

raj (sre): will monitor error budget and token costs. If embeds QPS creeps up again, next step is to toggle a stricter global per-route hard cap and enable 429 for non-tiered customers.

lucy (prod): thanks team. I'll draft the external post-incident note if needed.

emma (oncall): thanks all, handing off to Raj in 10. :white_check_mark:
